const cmd = `python3 -B -c 'import collections,re
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest())); recs=loader.load_path(Path("tome-orcs.lua"),logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").records
a=recs[3000]; tpl=re.compile(r"<\\?=?[^?]*\\?>")
print(a["section"],a["line"],a["source_tag"])
print("source",collections.Counter(tpl.findall(a["source"])))
print("target",collections.Counter(tpl.findall(a["target"])))
print("source_count",len(tpl.findall(a["source"])),"target_count",len(tpl.findall(a["target"])))'`;
